name: How long does a custom home addition project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a custom home addition project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a custom home addition varies significantly based on its size, complexity, and specific requirements, as well as local permitting timelines. While we can provide a more precise estimate after an initial consultation, projects can range from several months to over a year. Our extensive experience, with over 10,000 jobs completed over two decades, allows us to provide clear scheduling transparency and proactive communication about each phase of your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines for custom home additions vary widely based on scope and permitting, but AKN provides clear scheduling and communication.
